text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I gave that 'Body Temperature Log for 
Racing Umamusume' Hayahide recommended a 
try, 
you see. 
A most convenient thing it is.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
'Inverted Temperature'... 
It lays bare before my eyes 
this 'constitution unsuited to racing.'

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
An enemy to be struck down stands plain 
before me. 
Nothing could stir my spirit more. —Would 
you not agree?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Good—strike while the iron is hot. 
We shall devise a plan at once, based on 
these results. 
—Come, you as well. Lend me your wisdom.
